question.text: The Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) threshold for a company or trust investor in a Cat III AIF is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 5.23, UBO for company/trust investors is determined at 25% controlling ownership/entitlement interest as per PMLA Rules. The Trap: 10%/15%/51% are not the PMLA 25% threshold (15% applies to partnerships/unincorporated associations). Cross-Exam Context: Common with broker/MF KYC thresholds. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Deploy a UBO questionnaire at onboarding with rebuttable declarations for any structures between 25-51%.
